prompt:
Use these concept :

Vision is the ability to see the big picture and set a clear direction for yourself and others. When you juggle, you need to have a vision of where the objects are going and how they will land in your hands. You can’t just focus on one object at a time. You need to see the whole pattern and anticipate the next move.

Focus and concentration: juggling emphasizes the significance of focus and concentration. A momentary lapse in concentration can lead to dropped balls, just as a momentary lapse in leadership focus can result in missed opportunities or decreased team morale. Leaders must maintain a laser-like focus on their vision, values, and objectives, inspiring their team members to do the same.

Agility and adaptability is the ability to move quickly and gracefully in response to challenges and opportunities. When you juggle, you need to be agile enough to catch the objects as they come and throw them back with precision and timing. You can’t be rigid or slow. You need to be flexible and fast.

To outline a presentation about 

The Evolution of your Leadership Practice:
•	Impact to Self – Changes/Examples
•	Impact to Team/Business – Changes/Examples
response: In the Evolution of my Leadership Practice, I've seen significant personal growth by focusing on setting a clear vision and maintaining concentration on that vision. This has allowed me to guide my team more effectively, ensuring everyone is aligned with our goals. The impact on the team has been positive, with increased morale and productivity. By being agile and adaptable, I've been able to respond to challenges swiftly, which has contributed to the business's success.
